input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum-fee-on-termination payable by IBM, so it meets the preferred position. The only penalty and payment-adjustment mechanics run against MSL and in our favour: the responsiveness penalty (p0757) and the delinquent-shipment profit-rate adjustments (p0749-p0756, p0418-p0419). Purchase Order cancellation is at IBM's discretion with no cancellation charge on MSL default (p0722), and the only amounts IBM pays on cancellation or termination are cost reimbursements and negotiated prices for completed/partially completed Products and Parts (Sections 5.2-5.3, p0131-p0143), which are consideration for goods rather than a liquidated sum. Payment terms in Sections 6.1-6.2 impose no late-payment interest or penalty on IBM. No redline is warranted.

mappings.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
